designBoundary: Frozen before opening native execution outcomes. Source, source-history availability and issue/PR discovery identities inspected only.
intent: For native drive-memory invocations, establish exact current-run text write/readback and independently verified restored persistence, with actual repository access.

period.matching: Credit each distinct repository/run/attempt once at its protected command completion timestamp; interval start inclusive, end exclusive.

claims.sameRun: Original attempt-bound command execution and result establish writing exactly run_id=<actual numeric run id> plus LF to /tmp/gh-aw/drive-memory/smoke-drive.txt and reading those exact bytes back. Retain command, output, exit status and attempt/source identity. Agent PASS or editable issue text is not accepted.
claims.restoredPersistence: A prior independently accepted producer write is bound to a protected persisted drive receipt/state version, and a distinct later attempt restores that same state and independently reads matching bytes before replacing the file. Same-run readback is insufficient.
claims.repositoryAccess: Original attempt-bound git log --oneline -1 execution in the target checkout returns a real commit independently matched to retained immutable repository identity.
claims.fullGoal: Restored persistence, exact current-run write/readback, .txt-only drive contents, actual repository access, applicable source/import obligations and trigger-appropriate safe outputs are independently established. First-run absence is separate, not failure or proof of restoration.

separation.partialValue: Count independently demonstrated same-run exact write/readback even when persistence, reporting or repository-access evidence is missing.
separation.attribution: Attempt-bound originals may establish workflow-linked execution, not exclusive causation.
separation.discovery: Complete supplied issue/PR bidirectional candidate closure, with absent references retained; candidates are not accepted outcomes. Comments and deleted/edited-away outputs are outside this discovery inventory.
separation.missing: Missing protected commands, receipts, source bytes, timing or cohort coverage produce null for the dependent claim. Demonstrated failures do not become missing. A retained subset is a lower bound, not a complete weekly total.
separation.history: Preserve standard frozen unresolved acceptance. This instrument is an explicit same-source retrospective reconstruction, not evidence of ex-ante historical adoption. Verify actual introduction and parent; never use shallow history boundary or oldest output as adoption.
separation.recentMovement: Only abutting equal-duration periods with complete comparable native evidence may establish recent movement. No fallback across gaps.

skillImprovement: For memory smoke tests, expose exact same-run write/readback, protected cross-run restoration, repository access and reporting as separate facets; do not let an issue PASS or green job substitute for persistence.
